name: RuneScapeX
short: OSRS-only player stats, PvM, clues, progress and Grand Exchange prices.
description: OSRS companion cog for Red. Show player profiles, skill levels and XP, ranked boss and clue records, comparisons, gains since a prior snapshot and real-time OSRS Wiki Grand Exchange prices. No API key required.
author: ill-will-iam
install_msg: Load with [p]load runescapex, then use [p]rsx help. All commands are OSRS-only; [p]rsx <player> shows a profile. Keeps existing OSRS gains snapshots.
